sloka: तेन मुक्तः ततो बाणः शितः शत्रु निबर्हणः ।तेन अहम् ताडितः क्षिप्तः समुद्रे शत योजने ॥३-३८-१९॥
transliteration: tena muktaḥ tato bāṇaḥ śitaḥ śatru nibarhaṇaḥ ।tena aham tāḍitaḥ kṣiptaḥ samudre śata yojane ॥3-38-19॥

translations.english: Then Rama released a sharp arrow that could kill the enemy. It struck me and threw me at a distance of hundred yojanas into the sea.
